newsitem.title: MALI: Heavy rain kills five people in Timbuktu.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rain kills five people in Timbuktu.

text.p: Heavy rains in the Malian town of Timbuktu killed five people, some by electrocution, and injured many more, state radio reported on Wednesday.
The radio said the the downpour on Tuesday afternoon caused widespread damage.
Deaths from electrocution or localised flooding are not uncommon during heavy rain in poor districts of West African towns where homes and electrical installations are often make-shift.
